mechanics.claim: Draven's next basic attack is empowered to deal bonus physical damage.
mechanics.quote: empowering his next basic attack within {{fd|5.8}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack deals its total increased damage in a single instance of basic damage, and can trigger from an attack already in its wind-up.
mechanics.quote: ''Spinning Axe'' attacks deal their total increased damage in a single instance of {{tip|basic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Recasting Spinning Axe refreshes the buff and can add another axe (up to two can be held at once), letting Draven stack up multiple empowered attacks.
mechanics.quote: Recasting ''Spinning Axe'' will refresh the {{tip|buff}} and add another axe if possible.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not trigger against structures.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
